subject: Next steps / technical deep-dive + rotating time-slot options
content:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aiden Park <aiden.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Sofia Müller <sofia.mueller@nimbus-analytics.de>, Kenji Yamamoto <kenji.y@nimbus-analytics.jp>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Next steps / technical deep-dive + rotating time-slot options

Hi Aiden, Sofia, Kenji —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap from our discovery: you’re evaluating Redwood for high-throughput inference across hybrid deployments, primary goals are predictable latency under 50ms p95 for short chat flows and getting cost-per-1k tokens under a specific budget for embed/rerank workloads. You mentioned stakeholders across US, EU and APAC who want to attend the technical session.

Proposed next step: 60-minute technical deep-dive where our SE (Vivek) will walk through serving architecture, routing/fallback behavior, and a live throughput demo against a representative prompt set. We also want to align on a short mutual action plan (shared below).

Because your team spans three regions, I propose three rotating slot options so the same roles can join at reasonable times over a few weeks instead of everyone cramming into one awkward time. The goal is to ensure the primary technical owners from each region see the demo in normal working hours at least once.

Rotating options (pick one series or tell us preferences):
- Series A (US-friendly week):
  - Week 1: Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 CET (US morning, EU afternoon)
  - Week 2: Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 CET
  - Week 3: Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 CET
- Series B (EU-friendly week):
  - Week 1: Wed 09:30 CET / 00:30 PT / 17:30 JST (EU morning, APAC evening)
  - Week 2: Wed 09:30 CET / 00:30 PT / 17:30 JST
  - Week 3: Wed 09:30 CET / 00:30 PT / 17:30 JST
- Series C (APAC-friendly week):
  - Week 1: Thu 10:00 JST / 02:00 CET / 17:00 PT (APAC morning, US late afternoon previous day)
  - Week 2: Thu 10:00 JST / 02:00 CET / 17:00 PT
  - Week 3: Thu 10:00 JST / 02:00 CET / 17:00 PT

Concrete immediate asks:
1) Which series (A/B/C) do you prefer as a default?
2) If you prefer a single one-off meeting instead, propose 3 time slots this week and we’ll prioritize.
3) Confirm the attendees you want in the first session (we attached an attendee CSV template).

Attachments: One-pager + mutual action plan template attached. I’ve also opened a HubSpot record for the deal: ND-2026-039.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

---
From: Aiden Park <aiden.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Müller <sofia.mueller@nimbus-analytics.de>, Kenji Yamamoto <kenji.y@nimbus-analytics.jp>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 19:41:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps / technical deep-dive + rotating time-slot options

Thanks Marissa, good recap. We’ll definitely want Vivek on the deep-dive. Quick notes from our side:
- Sofia (EU) and Kenji (APAC infra lead) both prefer not to join anything earlier than 08:30 local.
- Our engineering lead (US) prefers afternoon PT for demos.

If we do a rotating series, Series A sounds most likely to get the US lead involved, but we’d like at least one slot that works for Sofia too. Can you propose one concrete week with dates (not just weekdays) so folks can check calendars? Also, could you share a Calendly link for the first session?

Attached is a very rough attendee list; I’ll confirm exact names once I coordinate with our TA.

Cheers,
Aiden
Aiden Park
Head of Product Integrations | Nimbus Analytics
aiden.park@nimbus-analytics.com | +1 212-555-0123

Subject: Re: Next steps / technical deep-dive + rotating time-slot options

Got it, thanks Aiden. I pulled some concrete calendar dates to make this easy. Below are three concrete one-off options for this week and then a suggested Series A schedule if you want to run the rotating weeks afterward. I’ll drop a Calendly link here for quick booking.

One-off options (this week) - converted to local times:
- Option 1: Thu Mar 12, 2026 — 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 CET (works for US & EU)
- Option 2: Fri Mar 13, 2026 — 08:30 PT / 11:30 ET / 16:30 CET (early for US, OK for EU)
- Option 3: Fri Mar 13, 2026 — 23:00 JST / 15:00 CET / 07:00 PT (APAC-local friendly; will be late for US)

Suggested Series A (rotating weeks, Tuesdays):
- Tue Mar 16, 2026 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 CET
- Tue Mar 23, 2026 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 CET
- Tue Mar 30, 2026 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 CET

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/technical-deep-dive (I created a 60-min slot named "Nimbus technical deep-dive")
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/999999999

Vivek, Ben — forwarding to confirm you can run the deep-dive on the suggested dates and whether you prefer Tue Mar 16 or Tue Mar 23 as the first session.

Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Next steps / technical deep-dive + rotating time-slot options

Hi all, Vivek here. Thanks for the heads up, Marissa. I can take the deep-dive and prefer Tue Mar 23 as the kickoff (gives me time to prepare a mini throughput test and tailored kernel selection notes). Confirming the proposed Series A times are fine for us.

A few prep asks from our side:
- Can you share a sample prompt set and expected sequence lengths for your chat flows? Prefer CSV or Google Sheet.
- Any regulatory constraints around token retention or on-prem requirements we should know about ahead of time?

I converted the Series A times to other zones for clarity: 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 CET is 02:00 JST next day — so APAC folks might prefer we rotate later for APAC-specific sessions (which is why we suggested rotating weeks).

Vivek Kulkarni

vivek@redwood.com | +44 20 7946 0958

Thanks, that all works. We’ll go with Series A and kick off with Tue Mar 23, 2026 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 CET. I confirmed the attendee list (attached) and added Sofia + Kenji as optional for the first session; they’ll definitely join at least one of the later rotated weeks.

Please send a calendar invite with Zoom and a short pre-read (one-pager is perfect). Looking forward to it.

Aiden
